## Verification Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with 0 errors
- [ ] `npm test` passes with all tests green
- [ ] `npm run build` completes cleanly
- [ ] Verified in browser / live Lichii session (if telemetry or UI changed)
- [ ] Verified Windows portable build (`npm run build:win`) if launcher or packaging changed
- [ ] UI text, comments, and docs are in English and contain no copyrighted game assets or personal dumps
